# registry_terraform_mirror_history (Data Source)

Lists the sync history entries for a Terraform/OpenTofu mirror configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "registry_terraform_mirror_history" "opentofu" {
  mirror_id = registry_terraform_mirror.opentofu.id
}

output "last_sync_status" {
  value = try(data.registry_terraform_mirror_history.opentofu.history[0].status, null)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mirror_id` (String) UUID of the Terraform mirror configuration.

### Read-Only

- `history` (Attributes List) Sync history entries, newest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--history))

<a id="nestedatt--history"></a>
### Nested Schema for `history`

Read-Only:

- `completed_at` (String) ISO 8601 timestamp when the sync completed (empty if still running).
- `id` (String) UUID of the history record.
- `message` (String) Optional status message or error detail.
- `started_at` (String) ISO 8601 timestamp when the sync started.
- `status` (String) Sync status: 'pending', 'running', 'succeeded', or 'failed'.
- `versions_new` (Number) Number of new versions discovered in this sync.
